text:
Maya: Quick sync  Satellite onramp drip: APAC + EMEA staggered sends tied to the benchmark webinar. 3-touch flow: Launch (announce), Reminder (48h), Last-chance (6h). Keep copy concise for mobile.

Ravi: Agree. Segment plan? webinar signups, trialing users, and docs-search (product keyword hits). Also separate out high-traffic ISPs for deliverability watch.

Lex: For localization: small variants per locale (EN, EN-AU, EN-NZ, EN-SG, EN-IN). Use local date formatting and time tokens. Avoid literal timezone strings in subject.

Priya: Subject tests: "Redwood benchmark: how we cut latency" vs "See the benchmark & join our webinar". Also test emojis vs no emoji in AU cohort.

Sam: Ops notes: Campaign-runner can do windowed sends. Recommend soft throttle: 4k/hr per region initially. Canary 5% for first batch, then ramp.

Maya: Good. Also include an experiment: CTA order swap (Demo first vs Deck first) for trial cohort only. Track both CTA clicks.

Lex: Creative: I'll produce two hero images (portrait & landscape) + animated GIF for preview. Will upload to drive: /marketing/campaigns/satellite-onramp/assets by EOD Mon.

Ravi: I'll map segments and export lists. Need deliverability exclusion list: unsub + bounce-hard + spam-trap. ETA Wed AM.

Priya: Reminder cadence: 48h after first send for non-openers, last-chance 6h before webinar start for registered but not confirmed. Use subject prefix "Reminder:" for reminder send.

Sam: Ops config (example):
```
campaign: satellite-onramp-v1
regions:
  - APAC:
      windows: ["2026-05-12T08:00+10:00/2026-05-12T10:00+10:00", "2026-05-12T14:00+10:00/2026-05-12T15:00+10:00"]
  - EMEA:
      windows: ["2026-05-12T09:00+01:00/2026-05-12T11:00+01:00"]
throttle_per_region: 4000
canary_pct: 5
ramp_steps: [5, 25, 60, 100]
```
I'll spin up the canary job tomorrow.

Maya: Ownership: Ravi = segments & exports, Lex = creatives, Priya = subject/preview tests + copy localization, Sam = ops/schedule, Maya = metrics/reporting.

Priya: Quick ask 4A1: can we include a benchmark snippet in the hero: "Median latency 30ms" with link to full deck? That copy might drive downloads.

Maya: Yes include small stat and always link to deck as secondary CTA.

Ravi: I'll add deliverability watchers and list a provider fallback in the sheet.

deploy-bot: Campaign created: id=cpn_sat_4567, scheduled canary for 2026-05-12T08:00+10:00.

Lex: I'll post mockups once uploaded, tag everyone.

Maya: Thanks team 680. We'll meet after 24h of the canary to decide ramp. Any blockers, call out here.
